messages:
micaela_sales: FYI — EU reseller (NorthernEdge, DE) is asking for an elevated channel discount for a strategic Enterprise deal. Need deal-desk + finance ok. @sasha_dealdesk @darren_partnerships

darren_partnerships: what's the exact ask and why is this outside the standard rate card?

micaela_sales: short version: reseller wants 30% off list for an initial POC (3 months) and a ramp to 25% if they deliver a $200k ARR commit within 12 months. Our EU partner rate card default is 20% off. Link to rate card: https://redwood.company/rate-cards/eu

sasha_dealdesk: do we have committed numbers for the customer? margin impact calc?

micaela_sales: customer potential ~ $250k ARR if closed. POC expected spend ~ $60k. Proposed concession: 30% off list for 90d POC, then revert to 20% unless partner signs a min-$200k commit, then partner gets 25% for 12 months. Also proposing one-off MDF €10k and co-sell credit. Example calc:

```
List price (example): $100k
30% discount => customer pays $70k
Partner commission proposed: 18% => $12.6k
Net to Redwood (approx): $70k - commissions/MDF
Delta vs standard (20%): ~ -$8k revenue in first-year on the POC slice
```

leah_finance: tagging finance concerns: we need a quick margin impact from RevOps and to ensure MDF is charged to the correct budget line. Also require forecast/CRM tagging + updated ARR model before approval.

arjun_ps: POC ask: we'll need ~40 eng hours to stand up a dedicated test env and run integration. Requesting a PS voucher to cover that time if this gets approved. Also note any SLA concessions must be in the SOW.

darren_partnerships: I'm tentatively +1 for a timeboxed POC concession (90 days) provided we get: 1) written partner commit for $200k ARR by EOM Q3, 2) partner addendum with MDF recoup clause, 3) legal signoff on channel terms. I'll escalate to RevOps for revenue impact signoff.

sasha_dealdesk: Opening formal deal-desk ticket WD-9843 to track approvals and conditions. Please drop financial calc + CRM opp id there. https://redwood.company/dealdesk/tickets/WD-9843 :thumbsup:

deal-bot: Ticket WD-9843 status: Open — Awaiting finance review and legal addendum.

micaela_sales: I'll upload the SOW draft and partner addendum to WD-9843 and add the CRM opp id. Will also confirm engineer names for the POC build. Thanks all :pray:
